title: Moon Microbes: 3 Real Survival Tricks

scenes.text: Scientists found bacteria surviving on the Moon for 30 days
The microbes formed protective spores that resist extreme vacuum
scenes.label: SPORING AGAINST VACUUM

scenes.text: Radiation‑hard DNA repair enzymes repaired DNA damage from solar particles
scenes.label: DNA REPAIR ENZYMES

scenes.text: A thin water film from lunar ice gave the cells enough moisture to stay active
scenes.label: WATER FILM FROM ICE
